verdict.rationale: Vestd documents UK-specific schemes, including qualifying EMI option scheme setup and granting, CSOPs, unapproved options and growth shares. It also has a share valuation offering and a 409A service for UK companies granting to US taxpayers, so the core of non-US valuations and UK tax-advantaged plans is covered. Missing for 10: explicit HMRC-agreed EMI valuation detail (the valuations page is evidenced only by its title), country-specific plans beyond the UK and US, multi-entity international support, and independent corroboration.
